## Problem Statement

<!-- What problem are you trying to solve? Be specific. Do not just describe the feature you want — describe the underlying need. -->

## Why Existing Functionality Does Not Address It

<!-- Explain why the current codebase cannot solve this problem without the proposed change. -->

## Proposed Solution

<!-- Describe what you would like to see built. Include any API design, data flow, or architecture considerations. -->

## Alternatives Considered

<!-- What other approaches did you consider, and why did you rule them out? -->

## Additional Context

<!-- Mockups, references, related issues, or any other context. -->

---

> **Before submitting:** Search open issues and discussions to confirm this has not already been proposed.
> Feature requests without a clear Problem Statement will be closed without review.
> For large features, open a Discussion first rather than an issue.
